reviewed_commit.description: The full HEAD commit SHA read from git during this review.

summary.description: The full two-axis review report in GitHub markdown: a '## Standards' section, a '## Spec' section, and the one-line totals summary the skill asks for.

findings.description: Individual findings worth an inline comment, anchored to the new (RIGHT) side of the PR diff.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root, exactly as it appears in the diff.

line.description: Line number in the NEW version of the file. Must be a line that appears in the PR diff (added or context line inside a hunk).

body.description: The comment text in GitHub markdown. Self-contained: cite the standard or spec line it rests on.
